player_prompt.intro:
Wo re yɛ Sokoban puzzle no. Wo ne player na wo hia sɛ wo tu boxes nyinaa kɔ targets.
        Sɛ wo ne box no bɛn koraa a, wo betumi atu no kɔ hɔ ase wɔ kwan no ara.
        Wo ntumi ntu box no fa wall mu, na wo ntumi ntu box no.
        Wɔ board no so, nneɛma no yɛ: 
        - Player (wo) pue sɛ 'P' 
        - Walls no yɛ '#' 
        - Boxes no yɛ 'X' 
        - Empty goals no yɛ 'O'
        - Boxes a wɔ goals no so yɛ '√'
        Wo betumi nso afa [w] sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kɔ soro, [a] sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kɔ benkum, [s] sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kɔ ase, na [d] sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kɔ nifa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nsiesie a wɔ de esiesie no nnyɛ fɔm no kɛse. De [up], [down], [left], [right] anaa [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Nsakrae a wɔde mae no nyɛ adeyɛ pa.
invalid_move.invalid_position: Akwantu a enni mu - wontumi mfa nni dwuma saa.

game_message.pushed_prefix: na wɔpompam adaka no bere a

outcome.win: Anigye! Woadi Sokoban asɛm no ho dwuma awie.
outcome.turn_limit: Wɔadu nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔdan no ho. Wuntumi nyi nsɛnnennen no ano.
